method: Compared all 19 authoritative sources/pages/page-NNN.png pages with the 80 manifest crops. Inspected native-resolution 40-pixel strips along each complete top, bottom, left and right crop edge, rotating side strips without resampling; inspected separate complete side strips for the three tall crops whose initial sheet truncated the right side. Opened additional individual crops and enlarged source details for ambiguous handwriting and the page-91 overlap. Pillow RGB decoded-pixel comparison found each crop identical in dimensions and every pixel to source.crop(manifest.rect). Printed numbers, variants, titles, attributions, signatures, barlines, lowest stems and analysis were checked against the page layout. Isolated irregular scan specks were distinguished from coherent pencil numerals, letters, arrows and circles. No OCR was used as evidence.
decision_policy: PASS requires the clean-crop checklist, not merely legible notation. RECROP_REQUIRED with source_limited=true means this source cannot supply a fully clean rectangular crop while retaining all required printed content; it does not authorize erasing handwriting or clipping notation. proposed_rect=null means no complete safe correction was established, not a recommendation to use the present crop. All four edges were reviewed for every entry. No corrected rectangles were proposed, so no proposed-rectangle acceptance tests apply. Chapter Markdown alt text and placement were outside the assigned review scope; manifest identity, image path, caption and printed page were checked.
